summary: Practise funder research, project logic, proposal budgets, and compliance checks. Explore this five-day resource mobilization training course.
lede: Proposal development training helps resource mobilization staff, proposal writers, programme teams and finance colleagues assess funding calls and prepare coherent applications. Participants practise prioritizing opportunities, developing project concepts and results frameworks, aligning budgets with activities, and checking funder requirements and submission details.
audienceIntro: This course suits staff who help identify funders, shape programme concepts, prepare applications, or coordinate the people and documents needed for a timely submission.
modules: Project Concepts and Theory of Change
Results Framework and OECD DAC Results
prerequisites: Familiarity with programme or project work is helpful. Basic use of spreadsheet and word-processing software supports the exercises; coding or programming is not required.
